title: 4.11 Everyday Verbs
unit_outcome: Name rooms and things at home, say where things are, talk about your morning and chores, and say the day, the time and the month.
goal: Use machen, sehen, benutzen, finden, geben and kommen; sehen and geben change their vowel (du siehst, er gibt).
grammar_function: Subject + verb + object; der-words take den/einen; geben + person + thing (dem Jungen ein Buch).
